name: Bavarois
source: A normal-looking pug that Hime picked up. For some reason, it can understand human speech and even talk like one through telepathy. Because Bavarois is a pug, it's very hostile towards pomeranians and poodles.
translation: A normal-looking pug that Hime picked up. For some reason, it can understand human speech and even talk like one through telepathy. Because Bavarois is a pug, it's very hostile towards pomeranians and poodles.
